documents.doc-cz-gibs-2026-09-08-gi-3794-4-cj-2026: The General Inspection of Security Forces stated on 8 September 2026, under ref. GI-3794-4/ČJ-2026-840502-P, that the filings delivered on 15 and 24 August 2026 concerning review of 2009-2019 proceedings and internal review of police procedures for determining THC in cannabis had been forwarded, according to subject-matter and territorial competence, to the Police Presidium of the Czech Republic for further measures. The Inspection also stated that it lacked authority to assess the challenged Police procedures or the factual and legal questions concerning evidence, and expressly treated the matter as disposed of on its side.
